title.en: Appealing styling cuts alongside safety concerns

text.en: Most pet owners praise the quality of dog grooming, noting pets come home smelling wonderful and looking neatly clipped. Clients appreciate long-lasting scents and attractive haircuts. However, one serious complaint reported a pet sustaining an eye ulcer from shampoo during bathing, requiring emergency veterinary treatment.

title.en: Caring breed handling with mixed safety

text.en: Several clients report positive experiences with staff who demonstrate good knowledge across diverse dog breeds and treat pets affectionately. Multiple reviewers return regularly with their dogs for ongoing maintenance. Conversely, a critical review raised concerns after an animal sustained an injury during a grooming appointment.

Pet parents frequently describe the salon staff and ownership as friendly, hands-on, and accommodating. Customers appreciate professional interactions during routine drop-offs. Nevertheless, dissatisfied reviewers felt management lacked empathy and accountability when handling grooming injuries and disputed pricing adjustments.

q.en: What do clients say about the quality of haircuts here?

a.en: Most pet owners report that dogs return neatly trimmed and smelling great, though one review reported an eye injury from shampoo.

q.en: How do prices compare for grooming services?

a.en: Reviews generally cite reasonable base prices, but one client warned of unexpected charges added without prior phone confirmation.

q.en: Do the groomers work with multiple dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the stylists are knowledgeable about different dog breeds and handle various coat types.
